title: Meet Granny: 11-Year-Old Lab Mix Is Laredo's Dog of the Week
excerpt: Granny, an 11-year-old Labrador mix, is this week's Dog of the Week at Laredo Animal Care Services. Senior dogs are free to adopt all November, and every other dog adoption is just $11.
content:
Granny, an 11-year-old Labrador mix, is this week's Dog of the Week at Laredo Animal Care Services, and she is looking for a home.

Granny has tiger-striped fur and a sweet, playful spirit. She is determined, too — she worked her way through a whole bone without stopping — and she loves getting pets and spending time with people.

Senior dogs are free to adopt for the entire month of November, in honor of National Senior Pet Month. Every other dog adoption is just $11 this month.

Every adoption includes spay or neuter surgery. The shelter, at 5202 Maher Ave., is Laredo's only open-admission shelter, taking in stray animals and pets whose owners can no longer care for them.

Senior pets are often the last to be adopted, even though they tend to be calmer and already settled in their personalities. Anyone thinking about adding a pet to the family is asked to consider giving an older animal a home this month — and Granny is ready to meet you.
